subject: Observability governance & onboarding — Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Greta Jensen <greta@atlaspayments.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Cc: PlatformOps <platformops@atlaspayments.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability governance & onboarding — Atlas Payments

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. We are ready to start the observability onboarding for Atlas Payments. High-level goals: ship a set of dashboards for transaction latency and error budgets, add tracing hooks for the tokenization and routing services, standardize an error taxonomy we can use for triage, and set up alert routing to our on-call rotation and your CS team.

Attached is a short requirements spreadsheet (atlas_requirements.xlsx) that includes current SLAs, teams, and what we currently capture. Our target is a limited go-live for core alerts and dashboards by July 10, then expand to full tracing coverage by July 24.

Can we book a kickoff this week? Prefer UTC mornings.

Thanks —
Greta Jensen
Head of Platform Reliability
Atlas Payments

ATTACHMENTS: atlas_requirements.xlsx
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Greta Jensen <greta@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability governance & onboarding — Atlas Payments

Greta —

Appreciate the brief. I'm looping in Monica (CS lead) to own the customer coordination and internal ops. Proposed plan attached: a 2-week sprint for dashboards + core alerts, then iterative tracing work. Key agenda for kickoff:

- Confirm pillar owners (tokenization, routing, payments API)
- Finalize alert routing & escalation matrix
- Share runbook template and triage playbook
- Access checklist for dashboards and tracing (Grafana keys, tracing env vars)

I attached a one-pager timeline (proposed_onboarding_timeline.pdf). Proposed kickoff: Thu Jun 28 at 09:00 UTC. Is that OK for your team?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

ATTACHMENTS: proposed_onboarding_timeline.pdf
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Atlas observability onboarding — task split and deadlines

Team —

Following Greta's notes and our proposed timeline, splitting tasks so we have clarity before the kickoff. Please reply with any concerns or if you need different offsets.

1) Dashboards & alerting (owner: Marcus) — baseline dashboards for TPS, p50/p95/p99 latency, error budget, and per-region availability. Deliver dashboard links and initial Grafana folder by 2028-07-03. Include short alt-text for each panel for CS.

2) Tracing hooks (owner: Aditya) — small instrumentation snippets for tokenization and routing services, link to example span conventions, and a staging-level tracer config. ETA for first-pass snippets: 2028-07-05.

3) Runbook & taxonomy (owner: Monica) — provide runbook_template_v1.md, propose taxonomy mapping for common errors (auth failures, quota, rate-limit, 5xx routing). Runbook draft by 2028-07-02.

4) Kickoff facilitation & CS comms (owner: Jasmine) — agenda, invite, and access checklist.

Operational notes: we will use the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onboarding-Atlas-Obs and will record the kickoff. Please upload any artifacts there.

Thanks —
Jasmine

Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Atlas observability onboarding — task split and deadlines

Jasmine —

I'll own dashboards + alert routing. Quick status: I provisioned a Grafana folder and populated three starter dashboards: transactions_overview, latency_percentiles, and error_budget. Links below. I added panel descriptions and short remediation hints where appropriate.

Grafana: https://grafana.atlas-payments.com/d/abc123/redwood-observability-baseline
Preview deck: https://drive.google.com/file/d/preview-dashboard-deck

Attachments: tracing-hook-snippets.zip (this contains example spans and a small library we use internally for trace context propagation). I coordinated with infra to expose a staging collector endpoint.

Open items:
- Need confirmation on alert thresholds from Atlas (Greta) for p99 latency and error budget cutover.
- Will produce the alert routing matrix (PagerDuty + CS escalation) and share by 2028-07-01.

I'll plan a 30-min demo during the kickoff to walk through dashboards and where to find annotations.

—Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

ATTACHMENTS: tracing-hook-snippets.zip
From: Greta Jensen <greta@atlaspayments.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability governance & onboarding — Atlas Payments

Jasmine / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Kickoff went great and the dashboards look sensible. We're confirming the p99 threshold and will send a brief matrix for PagerDuty routing by EOD.

Confirmed go-live for core dashboards + alert routing on 2028-07-10. Tracing rollout to follow with snippets from Aditya and Marcus; we'll validate in staging the week of July 11.

Appreciate the clear runbook template Monica provided — that will help our on-call team.

We'll share the signed access form via Drive and open a HubSpot note for the milestone.

Thanks to everyone — looking forward to the go-live.

Best,
Greta Jensen
Head of Platform Reliability
Atlas Payments
